chapters.label: Live: the 2022 final
chapters.text: The 2022 Futsal Euro final. Russia lead two one. Then Portugal get a kick-in. André Coelho drives it hard at goal. It hits the keeper’s leg and goes in. Two all!

chapters.label: Replay: the driven kick-in
chapters.text: Watch again. The ball sits on the line, and he hits it hard. The keeper cannot stop it! Later he scores again, and Portugal win four two. Champions of Europe!

chapters.label: Strike low and hard
chapters.text: In futsal, a low shot is the hardest to save. The keeper must get down fast, and legs get in the way. So strike it low and hard!
